description: Source code implementing a preload data decoder with classes for bit reading, Huffman decoding, and size decoding, used for parsing compressed data structures in the Chromium project.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Class for reading bits from a byte stream, supporting bit-by-bit reading, size decoding, and seeking.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding Huffman-encoded data using a predefined tree.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Next
methods.description: Reads the next bit from the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits from the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::DecodeSize
methods.description: Decodes a size value from the bit stream using a custom encoding scheme.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific bit offset in the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a character from the Huffman-encoded bit stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Main decoding function that searches for a string in the compressed data using Huffman and prefix decoding.
